description: Validate and register a custom hardware blueprint into the active catalog so unlisted equipment can be mounted. Pass the entire specification inside the top-level 'blueprint' object: 'blueprint.slug' must use lowercase kebab-case, ports may combine explicit 'ports[]' with repeating 'port_groups[]' macros whose coordinates fit strictly within 'blueprint.geometry' without overlapping, and 'slots[]' applies only when 'mount_type' is 'modular-carrier' whereas 'slot_compatibility' applies to 'sub-module'. Persists YAML to the local custom-catalog folder in stdio mode or session memory on remote servers, overwrites same-slug custom entries without touching mounted rack state or undo history, and returns status 'INVALID' instead of throwing on validation errors. Use only after search_catalog confirms hardware is unlisted; use mount_equipment instead to place an already registered blueprint into the rack.
